title: Environment Security (.env, .gitignore)
goal: Ensure secure environment variable handling with .gitignore configuration to prevent secrets exposure and .env.example template for development setup.

sub_tasks.title: Configure .gitignore for Environment Files
sub_tasks.output: Added .env, .env.local, .env.production to .gitignore to prevent secrets from being committed

sub_tasks.title: Create .env.example Template
sub_tasks.output: Created .env.example with all required environment variables (without actual values) for developer onboarding

sub_tasks.title: Verify No Hardcoded Secrets
sub_tasks.output: Audited codebase to ensure no API keys, passwords, or tokens are hardcoded

acceptance_criteria: Clear documentation for required environment variables
result_summary: Environment security properly configured. .gitignore prevents accidental commits of sensitive .env files. .env.example template provides clear guidance for developers on required environment variables without exposing actual secrets. Codebase verified to have no hardcoded credentials.
